units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 3. Within five working days after contract conclusion, the contracting authority shall send the information in paragraph 2, points 1–7, 9, 12 and 14, of this Article to the federal executive authority responsible for treasury servicing of budget execution. If contract terms are amended under this Federal Law, within five working days after amendment the contracting authority shall send that body the paragraph 2 information affected by the amendment. In the procedure established under paragraph 6 of this Article, information in paragraph 2, points 10 and 11, shall be sent no later than five working days starting on the day after performance of the contract or separate stage, or termination, respectively; information in paragraph 2(13) shall be sent no later than one working day starting on the day after the acceptance document is signed. If, under this Federal Law, the contract, acceptance document, amendment agreement, termination agreement or decision to refuse performance unilaterally is signed using the unified information system, those documents and the information they contain that is to be entered in the register shall be sent through that system for inclusion in the procedure established under paragraph 6 of this Article, no later than three working days starting on the day after the contract or agreements are signed or the decision enters into force, and on the day the acceptance document is signed.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 103

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 4. The federal executive authority responsible for treasury servicing of budget execution shall verify the presence of the information and documents in paragraph 2 of this Article and their compliance with the contract register maintenance requirements, and enter the information and documents in paragraph 2, points 1–14, no later than three working days following receipt. The exception is the information and acceptance document in paragraph 2(13), if signed without the unified information system in performing a contract containing no State secrets: these shall be entered no later than two working days following receipt. Information in the contract, acceptance document, amendment agreement, termination agreement or unilateral refusal decision referred to in paragraph 3 of this Article and signed using the unified information system shall be entered automatically through that system in the procedure established under paragraph 6 of this Article. Information and documents not meeting this paragraph and the maintenance procedure shall not be entered.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 103

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 5. Information and documents in the contract register shall be posted on the official website, except for procurement:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 103

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 1) in the cases specified in Article 24, paragraph 11, points 2, 3, 4, point 5, subpoints в–д, and points 6 and 7, and paragraph 12, and Article 93(1), points 3–5, 7, 10, 13, 17, 20, 21, 24, 26, 30, 40, 41, 42, 45, 50–52, 56, 59 and 61–63, of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 103

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 2) by contracting authorities specified in Article 24(11)(5), subpoints а and б, of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 103

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 3) for which special arrangements under Article 111(1) of this Federal Law provide that information and documents shall not be posted on the official website.
units.label: Point 3 Part 5 Art. 103

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 6. The Government of the Russian Federation shall establish the contract register maintenance procedure. It may set special rules for entry of information on contracts concluded under Article 93(1), points 4, 5, 23, 42, 44 and 46, of this Federal Law and their attachments, and for posting that information and those documents on the official website.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 103

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 7. Information on contracts containing State secrets shall be entered in a separate contract register, whose maintenance procedure is established by the Government of the Russian Federation. That information shall not be published in the media or posted on the Internet.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 103

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 8. A contract shall not be paid if the contract concluded under this Federal Law, with attachments if any, or its copy, and any amendment agreement have not been entered in the contract register, or if information on a contract containing State secrets and its amendment has not been entered in the separate register under paragraph 7 of this Article, except for such a contract concluded under Article 93(1), points 4 and 5, of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 103

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 9. Data contained in the information and documents under paragraph 2, points 10 and 13, of this Article shall be recorded in accounting registers after that information and those documents have been entered in the contract register under this Article.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 103

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.label: Art. 104

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 1. The register of bad-faith suppliers (contractors, service providers), also referred to as the register of bad-faith suppliers, shall be maintained in the unified information system by the federal executive authority authorised to exercise procurement oversight posting the information specified in this Article.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 104

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 2. The register shall include information on procurement participants that evaded conclusion of contracts and suppliers (contractors, service providers) that failed to perform or improperly performed contractual obligations.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 104

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 3. The following information on the procurement participants and suppliers (contractors, service providers) specified in paragraph 2 of this Article shall be entered in the register:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 104

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 1) full and abbreviated name, if any, of the legal entity, including a foreign legal entity, where the participant or supplier (contractor, service provider) is a legal entity; of an accredited branch or representative office of a foreign legal entity, where it acts for that entity; surname, given name and patronymic, if any, where the participant or supplier (contractor, service provider) is an individual, including a registered individual entrepreneur; and taxpayer identification number or, for a foreign person, its equivalent under the relevant foreign State's legislation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 104

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 2) surnames, given names, patronymics if any and taxpayer identification numbers, or foreign equivalents under the relevant foreign State's legislation, of members of the collegial executive body and the person acting as sole executive body. If the powers of the sole executive body have been transferred under Russian Federation legislation to another person, a manager or management organisation, the register shall also contain the manager's surname, given name and patronymic if any, the management organisation's name, and the taxpayer identification number or foreign equivalent;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 104

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 3) names, surnames, given names, patronymics if any and taxpayer identification numbers, or foreign equivalents under the relevant foreign State's legislation, excluding the name and taxpayer identification number of a public-law territorial entity, of:
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 104

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: а) participants or members of a corporate legal entity able to influence the activities of that entity as a procurement participant or supplier (contractor, service provider) specified in paragraph 2 of this Article. For this Federal Law, these are persons who alone or together with their affiliated person or persons own more than twenty-five percent of the shares, interests or units in the corporate legal entity. Affiliation shall be determined under Russian Federation antimonopoly legislation;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 3 Part 3 Art. 104

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: б) founders of a unitary legal entity;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 3 Part 3 Art. 104

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 4) the entry number in the unified register of procurement participants, for electronic procedures and closed electronic procedures;
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 104

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 5) the procurement identification code. Information under this point shall not be posted on the official website;
units.label: Point 5 Part 3 Art. 104

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 6) Repealed from 1 January 2022. — Federal Law of 02.07.2021 No. 360-FZ;
units.label: Point 6 Part 3 Art. 104

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 7) the date on which the information is entered in the register of bad-faith suppliers.
units.label: Point 7 Part 3 Art. 104

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 4. The contracting authority or an authorised body or institution vested with powers under Article 26 of this Federal Law shall request the authorised federal procurement oversight authority to enter information on a participant or supplier (contractor, service provider) in the register within the periods specified in Article 51(6)(2)(б), Article 73(14)(4)(в) and Article 95(16) and (22.2) of this Federal Law, or no later than two working days following receipt by the contracting authority of a court decision terminating the contract for a substantial breach by the supplier (contractor, service provider).
units.label: Part 4 Art. 104

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 5 - 6. Repealed from 1 July 2021. — Federal Law of 30.12.2020 No. 539-FZ.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 104 · “5 - 6. Repealed from 1 July 2021. — Federal Law of 30.12.2020…”

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 7. Within five working days after receipt of the request in paragraph 4 of this Article, the authorised federal procurement oversight authority shall verify the facts stated in it indicating evasion of contract conclusion by a participant, termination by a court for substantial breach by the supplier (contractor, service provider), unilateral refusal by the contracting authority for substantial breaches by the supplier (contractor, service provider), or absence of grounds for the supplier's (contractor's, service provider's) unilateral refusal. It shall then decide whether to enter the relevant information in the register of bad-faith suppliers or refuse entry. If entry of information on the persons specified in paragraph 2 of this Article is ordered, it shall be made no later than three working days after that decision.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 104

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 8. Information in the register of bad-faith suppliers shall be posted in the unified information system and made available for inspection free of charge.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 104

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 9. Information under paragraph 3 of this Article shall be removed from the register two years after the date on which the authorised federal procurement oversight authority was required to post it under paragraph 7 of this Article, or before that period expires if that authority receives:
units.label: Part 9 Art. 104

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 1) a court decision:
units.label: Point 1 Part 9 Art. 104

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: а) invalidating the authorised federal procurement oversight authority's decision to enter information on the participant or supplier (contractor, service provider) in the register;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 9 Art. 104

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: б) declaring the contracting authority's unilateral refusal to perform unlawful or invalid;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 9 Art. 104

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 2) information confirming that, as at the date the participant was deemed to have evaded conclusion or the date the contract was terminated, the persons specified in paragraph 3, points 2 and 3, of this Article could not influence the activities of the participant or supplier (contractor, service provider).
units.label: Point 2 Part 9 Art. 104

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 10. The Government of the Russian Federation shall establish the register maintenance procedure, which shall provide, in particular, for:
units.label: Part 10 Art. 104

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 1) the procedure for requesting entry of information on a participant or supplier (contractor, service provider), and requirements for the request's composition, content and form;
units.label: Point 1 Part 10 Art. 104

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 2) the procedure for consideration of such requests by the authorised federal procurement oversight authority and the grounds for deciding to enter or refuse to enter information on a participant or supplier (contractor, service provider). Those grounds shall include refusal to enter information on a supplier (contractor, service provider) if force majeure made proper performance of the contract impossible;
units.label: Point 2 Part 10 Art. 104

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 3) the procedure for sending a decision to enter information on a participant or supplier (contractor, service provider), or to refuse entry;
units.label: Point 3 Part 10 Art. 104

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 4) the procedure for removing information under paragraph 3 of this Article from the register.
units.label: Point 4 Part 10 Art. 104

units.locator: Article 104. Register of unscrupulous suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 11. An interested person may challenge in court the inclusion of information on a participant or supplier (contractor, service provider) in the register, the information it contains, or failure to take the actions specified in paragraph 9 of this Article.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 104

units.locator: Chapter 6. APPEALS AGAINST ACTIONS (OMISSIONS) OF ENTITIES SUBJECT TO CONTROL
units.text: Chapter 6. APPEALS AGAINST ACTIONS (OMISSIONS) OF ENTITIES SUBJECT TO CONTROL
units.label: Chapter 6. APPEALS AGAINST ACTIONS (OMISSIONS) OF ENTITIES SUBJECT TO CONTROL

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.label: Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 1. In competitive procedures and procurement under Article 93(12) of this Federal Law, a procurement participant may, under Russian Federation legislation, challenge acts or omissions of an oversight subject or subjects in court or before a procurement oversight body under this Chapter if they infringe its rights and lawful interests. A challenge under this Chapter does not preclude a judicial challenge.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 2. A participant may file a complaint against acts or omissions of an oversight subject or subjects, also referred to as a complaint, with a procurement oversight body during supplier (contractor, service provider) selection, but no later than five days starting on the day after the final selection record is posted in the unified information system or signed in a closed tender or closed auction, subject to the following:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 1) a complaint against provisions of a procurement notice or procurement documentation, where documentation is required by this Federal Law, may be filed before the application deadline. A participant may file only one complaint against those provisions. If the notice or documentation is amended under this Federal Law, the participant may file only one complaint against its provisions after those amendments;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 2) a complaint against acts or omissions of an oversight subject or subjects occurring after the date and time of the application deadline may be filed only by a participant that submitted an application;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 3) a complaint against acts or omissions of an electronic platform or specialised electronic platform operator during a participant's accreditation, submission of an application to the operator, or posting of a preliminary offer on the electronic platform may be filed no later than five days after the challenged acts or omissions;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 4) a complaint against acts or omissions of an oversight subject or subjects during contract conclusion after the final selection record is posted in the unified information system or signed in a closed tender or closed auction may be filed by the participant with whom the contract is being concluded or a participant deemed to have evaded conclusion, no later than the date of contract conclusion;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 5) a single complaint may not cover acts or omissions of an oversight subject or subjects in several procurements.
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 3. A complaint under this Article shall be filed with:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 1) the federal executive authority authorised to exercise procurement oversight, for procurement for federal, constituent-entity or municipal needs, and for challenges to acts or omissions of an electronic platform or specialised electronic platform operator;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 2) the oversight body for the State defence order, for procurement for federal needs under the State defence order;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 3) the constituent entity's executive authority authorised to exercise procurement oversight, for procurement for constituent-entity needs and the needs of municipalities within its territory;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 4) the local self-government body authorised to exercise procurement oversight, for procurement for municipal needs.
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 4. In electronic procedures and closed electronic procedures, a complaint may be filed with the procurement oversight bodies in paragraph 3 of this Article only through the unified information system, by preparing and posting the following information there:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 1) the name of the procurement oversight body specified in paragraph 3 of this Article with which the complaint against acts or omissions of the oversight subject or subjects is filed;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 2) the procurement participant's name as recorded in the unified register of procurement participants;
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 3) the procurement identification code, except where this Federal Law does not require it and where a complaint concerns a platform operator's acts or omissions during accreditation on an electronic or specialised electronic platform or posting of a preliminary offer on an electronic platform. Several procurement identification codes may not be specified, except codes for procurement under Articles 25 and 26 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 3 Part 4 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 4) the name of the oversight subject or subjects whose actions are challenged;
units.label: Point 4 Part 4 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 5) the challenged acts or omissions and the grounds of the complaint;
units.label: Point 5 Part 4 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 6) the entry number in the register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities, or in the register of agreements under Federal Law No. 223-FZ of 18 July 2011 On Procurement of Goods, Work and Services by Certain Types of Legal Entities, for the contract or agreement specified in Article 31(2.1) of this Federal Law whose performed obligations meet that paragraph's value and time requirements, where requirements under Article 31(2.1) of this Federal Law have been imposed and performance information is posted in the unified information system under this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 6 Part 4 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 5. The information in paragraph 4 of this Article shall be posted automatically through the unified information system in the register under Article 99(21) of this Federal Law, except where:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 1) the procurement participant is not registered in the unified information system;
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 2) the complaint breaches the first subparagraph or points 1 and 4 of paragraph 2, or paragraph 4, of this Article;
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 3) the register of bad-faith suppliers (contractors, service providers) under this Federal Law contains information on the complaining participant, including its members, members of its collegial executive body or person acting as sole executive body where it is a legal entity, provided that the contracting authority has imposed the requirement in Article 31(1.1) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 3 Part 5 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 6. Before the date of substantive consideration by the procurement oversight body, the participant may withdraw its complaint through the unified information system by preparing withdrawal information for automatic posting in the register under Article 99(21) of this Federal Law. The oversight body shall then not consider the merits. The participant may not file another complaint against the same acts or omissions of the oversight subject or subjects in the procurement concerned.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 105
